name: Stack AI
description: Find, run, and edit StackAI projects, search knowledge bases, and inspect runs.

methods.whenToUse: Use browser sign-in for the hosted StackAI MCP server.
methods.guidanceMd: Sign in to StackAI, then confirm the active organization. A read-only connection hides create, edit, upload, run and evaluator-preview tools.
methods.label: Sign in with StackAI
warnings: Running a project or generating evaluation results can run its integrations, and updating a skill changes the version agents use immediately. Keep those actions on Ask first.
